craft_notes: Sthāyin: refuge of the incapable. Device: end-dash→comma (plight stated softly, hold released). Rejected: 'shiftless' synonyms — killed: aśakta incapacity kept plain. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: 'Feckless, what feat can I?' — to him who plots no path at all,
all-helping Force of the Benign: my hold.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kim aśaktaḥ karomīti sarvatrānadhyavasyataḥ sarvānugrāhikā śaktiḥ śāṃkarī śaraṇaṃ mama

reads_against.argmap: 'What can I, incapable, do?' — for one resolving nothing anywhere.; All-befriending power, Śaṅkara's: my refuge. → Śaṅkara's all-befriending power is refuge for the resolveless.
c1_essence: Desire withdrawn, longing stretched, moon-crested master bowed; incapable refuge in all-befriending power.
reads_against.l2: Crying 'incapable, what can I do?' with nowhere a resolve to stand on — Śaṅkara's grace that befriends all is where I hide.
